query: WITH locked AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT d.id FROM porchlight.devices d JOIN porchlight.sessions s ON s.device_id=d.id WHERE s.id=$1 AND d.revoked_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED), touched AS (UPDATE porchlight.sessions SET expires_at=$2,last_used_at=now() WHERE id=$1 AND device_id IN (SELECT id FROM locked) AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now() AND last_used_at<=now()-interval '1 hour' RETURNING device_id) UPDATE porchlight.devices SET last_seen_at=now() WHERE id IN (SELECT device_id FROM touched)
